items.text: Comment on a passage: select words while editing and press **Ctrl/Cmd+R** (or **Comment on selection** in the command palette or the right-click menu of selected text) to add a child comment that quotes them. On a wide window the comments move to a column beside the text, each next to the words it quotes, and are edited there; Enter in a comment adds a reply. Comments and replies draw no bullet: a thin line and a small indent show depth, and the author chip is the handle for dragging and for the block menu.
